newsitem.title: FRANCE: ONIC seen raising 1996/97 maize export forecast.
newsitem.headline: ONIC seen raising 1996/97 maize export forecast.

text.p: French cereals office ONIC has provisionally raised its estimate for 1996/97 maize exports inside the European Union by 300,000 tonnes to 5.92 million tonnes, grain industry sources said on Monday.
This would compare with exports of 6.087 million in 1995/96 (July/June).
In a draft new report, ONIC has cut its target for maize exports to countries outside the EU to 200,000 tonnes from last month's target of 250,000.
This would compare with 1995/96 maize exports to non-EU countries of 164,000 tonnes.
The draft also says France will end the 1996/97 season with a maize carryover of 2.827 million tonnes against the 2.741 million forecast last month and 1.653 million at end-June 1996.
The draft also raises ONIC's estimate for the 1996 maize crop to 13.997 million tonnes from 13.624 million officially forecast last month and 12.394 million produced last year.
The figures were drawn up by an industry panel for publication on December 12.
Although changes are infrequent, the figures may be fine-tuned before publication.
